edgeBE.pinned_note: PINNED 2026-10-05 by hand, not by HAT_groin_joint_fit.py. Blocking groin, b = 0.6 (the share of alongshore transport blocked at the GIS 5|6 face), f = 0.6 after the instant 2004 failure. Fitted on the DEM-to-DEM calibration period 1996-2009 with the solved edgeBE ends, by date RMSE of the D5-D6 gap at the 1997/2004/2008 photos (4.0 m, against 69.2 m with no groin); f is loosely constrained (0.5-0.8 within a few metres). See hard-structures/groin/groin-module-test/1-dem-to-dem/2026-10-05-blocking-fit-calibration/README.md. M is carried only because HAT_run_all reads it; the blocking groin ignores it. The superseded dipole pin (M 60, f 0.6) is in this file in git history before 2026-10-05, with a local copy at archive/joint_fit_dipole_M60_pin_20260830.json (archive/ is not tracked). RE-RUNNING STAGE 5 WILL OVERWRITE THIS FILE.
